items.title: ﻿nix flake doesnt have an aarch64-darwin package so doesnt work on my mac
items.body:
the repo actually has a mac binary but the flake doesnt include it. 

proposed fix:
```diff
diff --git a/.github/workflows/nix.yml b/.github/workflows/nix.yml
--- a/.github/workflows/nix.yml
+++ b/.github/workflows/nix.yml
@@ -21,4 +21,5 @@ jobs:
         run: |
           nix eval --raw .#packages.x86_64-linux.pun.drvPath
           nix eval --raw .#packages.aarch64-linux.pun.drvPath
+          nix eval --raw .#packages.aarch64-darwin.pun.drvPath
           nix flake check --no-build --all-systems
diff --git a/README.md b/README.md
--- a/README.md
+++ b/README.md
@@ -50,7 +50,8 @@ yay -S pushin-cli-bin
 #### Nix / NixOS

 The flake packages the checked-in, static Linux binary for `x86_64-linux` or
-`aarch64-linux` (no Rust compilation). To run it once without installing:
+`aarch64-linux`, and macOS binary for `aarch64-darwin` (no Rust
+compilation). To run it once without installing:

 ```sh
 nix run 'git+https://git.pushin.eu/pjullrich/pushin-cli.git#pun' -- --version
diff --git a/flake.nix b/flake.nix
--- a/flake.nix
+++ b/flake.nix
@@ -24,6 +24,7 @@
       systems = [
         "x86_64-linux"
         "aarch64-linux"
+        "aarch64-darwin"
       ];
       lib = nixpkgs.lib;
       toolVersions = builtins.listToAttrs (
diff --git a/nix/package.nix b/nix/package.nix
--- a/nix/package.nix
+++ b/nix/package.nix
@@ -9,6 +9,7 @@ let
     {
       x86_64-linux = "linux-x86_64";
       aarch64-linux = "linux-arm64";
+      aarch64-darwin = "macos-universal";
     }
     .${stdenvNoCC.hostPlatform.system}
       or (throw "pun: unsupported platform ${stdenvNoCC.hostPlatform.system}");
@@ -46,6 +47,7 @@ stdenvNoCC.mkDerivation {
     platforms = [
       "x86_64-linux"
       "aarch64-linux"
+      "aarch64-darwin"
     ];
     sourceProvenance = [ lib.sourceTypes.binaryNativeCode ];
   };
```

just fyi, cant do intel mac support because nixpkgs dropped support for that. just in case you were wondering.

cant open PR for this because of issue #10 i filed. happy to submit once i can fork.
